lines.text: Wait! Why Penguin Feet Never Freeze on -40° Ice!
Most kids guess totally wrong about why penguins feet dont freeze!
Stop and picture what actually happens inside.
Penguins use clever warm-to-cold heat-swap blood vessels in their legs.
so feet stay just above freezing while keeping core bodies toasty.
Nature uses amazing science tricks right under our noses!
Even many grown-ups still believe the old rumor instead of this fact!
Now you know the real truth behind Ice-Proof Feet!
